items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: There was an Indonesian bass player working with Bishop named Eddie de Hass whom we engaged also for the coming tour.

ctx.x: Lily and I were planning another tour of France for the fall and we talked to Bishop about making the tour with us because Donald Brown was not and would not be experienced enough for a concert tour at the time we planned to do it. Bishop accepted. There was an Indonesian bass player working with Bishop named Eddie de Hass whom we engaged also for the coming tour.

The job at the Moulin Rouge was a drag more and more each day. One night there was only one man in the bar, and we were playing as if the place was full. Finally, this fellow left and it was almost 3'30, so I started playing "Goodnight Sweetheart", which was our closing theme. I looked at the cashier to get her reaction, and she was making a sign to me not to finish. I went over to her and asked her why should we continue when there was no one in the place, Her reply was that someone may come in. So we had to…
